name: WSPR TX
description: K1JT's Weak Signal Propagation Reporter, transmit side: callsign/grid/power packed to 50 bits, K=32 rate-1/2 convolutional FEC, bit-reversal interleave, the 162-bit sync vector, 4-FSK 1.4648 Hz tones for 110.6 s — fired 1 s into the even UTC minute. Arm as a repeating beacon, send untimed for tests, or save a 12 kHz WAV. Decodable 28 dB below the noise; wsprnet.org draws the map.
author: Ham Radio Web Studio
